capabilities.title: Three-column desktop shell with independently collapsible and resizable supporting panels
capabilities.contract: The Article remains the central column at viewport height.

capabilities.title: Focus mode hides both supporting panels without changing Article data
capabilities.contract: Focus mode changes only local layout state.
capabilities.persistence: No Article metadata, Draft, or Revision changes.

capabilities.title: Create, search, select, and list Articles by latest persisted activity
capabilities.contract: Selected Article is restored locally and Article activity includes retained Draft checkpoints.
capabilities.persistence: Article service plus local workspace preferences.

capabilities.title: Persisted conversation, explicit Quick actions, selection scope, streaming, cancellation, and recovery
capabilities.contract: A skill tag never sends a request; generated text remains a Proposal until accepted.
capabilities.persistence: Per-Article Assistant records and explicit Editorial Requests.

capabilities.title: Quiet empty state creates an Article using the configured default language
capabilities.contract: Creation does not create a Revision outside Article creation.

capabilities.title: Title, language context, Revision promotion, focus mode, and confirmed Article deletion
capabilities.contract: Metadata changes do not create a Revision and deletion requires confirmation.
capabilities.persistence: Article metadata PATCH, local target-language guidance, and Article deletion route.

capabilities.title: Seven keyboard-operable Workspace Views with revision-aware actionable and stale badges
capabilities.contract: Each View has stable tab and panel identifiers, labels, and Arrow, Home, and End navigation.
capabilities.persistence: Active View is a local workspace preference; results retain their Article and base Revision.

capabilities.title: Constrained Markdown writing surface with formatting toolbar and safe rich-text paste conversion
capabilities.contract: Article content is persisted as supported Markdown, never editor JSON or raw imported HTML.
capabilities.persistence: Draft lifecycle owns recoverable text persistence.

capabilities.title: Debounced current Draft checkpoints with switch, Settings-entry, and page-hide flushing
capabilities.contract: A Current Draft is mutable, versioned, and never a Revision.
capabilities.persistence: Per-Article Draft checkpoint anchored to the current Revision.

capabilities.title: Explicit promotion of the exact Current Draft checkpoint into one immutable Revision
capabilities.contract: Revision promotion clears only the matching Draft checkpoint and creates one Revision.
capabilities.persistence: Versioned Draft checkpoint and immutable Article Revision.

capabilities.title: Recoverable Draft and Revision conflict resolution without replacing local text implicitly
capabilities.contract: The author explicitly keeps local text, uses the retained Draft, or uses the current Revision.
capabilities.persistence: Conflict responses include current Article and retained Draft data when available.

capabilities.title: Selectable Proposal review with rejection, stale warning, and explicit immutable Revision acceptance
capabilities.contract: AI-generated text never enters the Article without explicit acceptance; stale Proposals cannot be accepted.
capabilities.persistence: Proposal base Revision and accepted Revision provenance.

capabilities.title: Immutable newest-first Revision history, read-only preview, and confirmed restoration
capabilities.contract: Selecting a Revision is local-only and restoring creates a new Revision.
capabilities.persistence: Immutable Article Revisions and recoverable Draft checkpoints.

capabilities.title: Revision-tied advisory Fact Check and local Style Profile results with stale indication
capabilities.contract: Findings never modify Article text and raw style samples remain local.
capabilities.persistence: Completed Editorial artifacts and local Style corpus.

capabilities.title: Explicit creation of an independently recoverable linked translation Article
capabilities.contract: A stale source blocks creation and translation text never overwrites its source Article.
capabilities.persistence: Independent Article with source Article and Revision linkage.

capabilities.area: Publishing Preview and Article Status Bar
capabilities.title: Article-specific profile selection and deterministic copy-ready character guidance
capabilities.contract: Character limits are guidance only and direct platform publishing is not performed.
capabilities.persistence: Article publishing-profile metadata with persisted default fallback.

scenarios.title: Constrained layout collapses supporting panels before narrowing the Article Workspace
preconditions: Desktop workspace with both supporting panels requested open
scenarios.event: Viewport becomes narrower than the requested three-column layout.
expected: Assistant Panel collapses before the Article Library Panel
Article Workspace remains first in keyboard and visual order
forbidden: Persisting temporary responsive collapse as a user preference

scenarios.title: Focus mode hides supporting panels without changing Article state
preconditions: An Article is open in the workspace
expected: Only the Article Workspace remains visible
forbidden: Changing Article content, metadata, Draft checkpoints, or Revisions

scenarios.title: Article Library creates and selects Articles while preserving activity order
scenarios.event: Author creates or selects an Article.
expected: The current Article updates and local selection is persisted
Recent ordering uses Article or Draft-checkpoint activity
forbidden: Creating a Revision merely by selecting an Article

scenarios.title: Quick action inserts a skill tag and Send remains the sole request trigger
preconditions: An Article is open and Assistant is idle
scenarios.event: Author selects a Quick action then sends guidance.
expected: The skill tag is inserted into the composer before the request
forbidden: Sending an Editorial Request when selecting a Quick action

scenarios.title: Empty workspace creates a new Article with default language
scenarios.event: Author activates Create Article from the empty workspace.
expected: A blank Article becomes current

scenarios.title: Header metadata remains separate from Revision promotion and deletion requires confirmation
scenarios.event: Author updates title or requests deletion.
expected: Title persists without a Revision
Deletion requires confirmation
forbidden: Deleting an Article without explicit confirmation

scenarios.title: Every Workspace View has a tab-panel relationship and roving keyboard navigation
preconditions: Article Workspace tab bar is rendered
scenarios.event: Author uses Arrow, Home, or End on a Workspace Tab.
expected: The corresponding View becomes selected and focused
forbidden: Missing tab, panel, or stable identifier for a Workspace View

scenarios.title: Current Article and Workspace View restore from versioned local preferences
preconditions: A valid versioned workspace preference exists
expected: The saved Article and Workspace View restore
forbidden: Persisting Workspace View into Article history

scenarios.title: Rich-text paste retains supported Markdown and removes unsafe or unsupported content
preconditions: Article Editor is ready for paste
expected: Supported semantic Markdown is retained
forbidden: Persisting raw HTML, executable elements, media, or unsafe links

scenarios.title: Editing creates a recoverable Draft checkpoint after idle time
scenarios.event: Author edits the writing surface and the idle delay elapses.
expected: The Draft becomes checkpointed against the current Revision
forbidden: Creating a Revision during ordinary checkpointing

scenarios.title: Latest Draft text flushes before Article switch, Settings entry, and page hiding
preconditions: Current Article has unsaved local Draft text
scenarios.event: Author switches Article, enters Settings, or hides the page.
expected: Latest text is checkpointed before the context changes

scenarios.title: Older checkpoint completion cannot overwrite a newer local Draft state
scenarios.event: Author makes another edit before the request completes.
expected: The lifecycle remains dirty for the newer content
forbidden: Displaying the older content as the current checkpoint

scenarios.title: Explicit save promotes only the matching checkpoint into one Revision
scenarios.event: Author saves the Article as a Revision.
expected: One immutable Revision is created and the matching Draft clears
forbidden: Promoting a mismatched or stale Draft version

scenarios.title: Draft conflict retains local text until author chooses a recovery path
preconditions: A checkpoint or promotion conflicts with newer persisted state
scenarios.event: Server returns Draft or Revision conflict data.
expected: The author can keep local text, use retained Draft text, or use the current Revision
forbidden: Replacing local Draft text without author choice

scenarios.title: Stale Proposals remain reviewable but cannot be accepted
preconditions: Proposal base Revision is no longer current
scenarios.event: Author attempts to accept selected changes.
expected: The stale warning is visible and acceptance is disabled
forbidden: Applying AI-generated text to a newer Article Revision

scenarios.title: Restoring a Revision keeps history immutable and resolves uncommitted Drafts explicitly
scenarios.event: Author chooses restore and resolves any uncommitted Draft.
expected: A new Revision is created without rewriting existing history
forbidden: Replacing history or silently discarding a Draft

scenarios.title: Findings are Revision-tied advisory output
scenarios.event: Author reviews Fact Check or Style Profile output.
expected: Findings retain freshness state and source context
forbidden: Changing Article text from advisory output

scenarios.title: Translation creation is blocked when its source Revision is stale
preconditions: Translation output is based on an older source Revision
scenarios.event: Author attempts to create the linked translation Article.
expected: The stale warning is visible and creation is disabled
forbidden: Overwriting the source Article or creating from stale source content

scenarios.title: Over-guidance character state remains non-blocking and accessible
preconditions: Publishing text exceeds the selected profile guidance
scenarios.event: Author views the Article Status Bar or Publishing Preview.
expected: Over-guidance state is visible without disabling profile selection or copying
forbidden: Blocking Article editing or direct copy
